parsed.summary: The graph merges many different routes into shared nodes, but the `requires` lists assume facts that only one route establishes. As a result most mid-book and late nodes and endings have routes that arrive without a required fact. The beacon payoff thread, the sheepfold payoff thread and the fn_up path are also broken, and several choices can never be offered.

findings.problem: fn_up requires `wren_head_torch`, which no node establishes; fn_torch only establishes `head_torches`. fn_up is also reached from oil_taper, pp_top, pp_count and pa_meet, none of which pass through fn_torch.
findings.route_or_state: Any route into fn_up, e.g. oil_taper -> c_oil_taper_1 -> fn_up.

findings.problem: The fn_up payoff requires `arthur_tremlett` and `arthur_at_gate`, which only the fn_count payoff site establishes. fn_up and fn_count are on disjoint branches: fn_up comes from oil_taper, pp_top, pp_count and pa_meet, while fn_count comes from oil_relight, oil_message, pp_pair and pa_blown. The beacon thread's second payoff therefore has no setup on any route.
findings.route_or_state: did_start_beacon_steps=true, arriving at fn_up via oil_taper/pp_top/pp_count/pa_meet.

findings.problem: fx_short_end requires `steps_layout`, which only bs_hub establishes. It is reached only when did_start_beacon_steps is false, and bs_hub is entered only by the choice that sets that variable to true. The ending can never satisfy its requirement.

The oil_bench payoff requires `biscuits_given`, which only the oil_can payoff (site2) establishes. A reader who reaches oil_bench via gt_oil or gt_wind never passed through oil_can. The passage presupposes biscuits that were never shown being handed over.

fx_gate requires `walker_ankle` and `ovens_field_gate`. fn_count and fn_taper establish neither, and ovens_field_gate comes only from sf_hub or sf_gate. The beacon-start route never visits the Sheepfold hub, so the gate is never introduced.

fn_taper requires `six_out` and `shoulder`, and fx_leeward requires `six_out`. Only fn_count (and for shoulder, fn_up/pa_blown) establishes them. fn_taper is reached from oil_count, pp_keep, pa_ninety and pa_hold, and fx_leeward from fn_wait and fn_hall (fn_hall via c_fn_hall_0), none of which come through fn_count. The finale passages describe lanterns blown out on the shoulder that this reader was never told about.

fn_signal requires `priya_party`, which only gt_word establishes. fn_signal is reached from oil_relight, oil_message, pp_pair and pa_blown, which are mostly on other branches. Related late nodes (fx_early_end, z_seen) have the same unmet requirement.
findings.route_or_state: gt_oil -> oil_can -> oil_school -> oil_line -> oil_relight -> fn_signal.

findings.problem: gt_word requires `path_rerouted`, which only sf_hub establishes. It is reached from bs_test and og_check, whose routes never visit the Sheepfold hub.
findings.route_or_state: n_list -> og_hub -> og_hooks -> og_check -> c_og_check_1 -> gt_word.

findings.problem: Several pp_ nodes require facts established on only one branch. pp_teach needs `wire_method` (bs_wire only). pp_twins needs `twins_kit_row` (og_twins only). pp_quad needs `mr_ovens` (sf_hub only). pp_keep needs `teams_plan` (pp_teams only), yet is reached via pp_rota from pp_teach and pp_quad. The same holds for pa_gaps->pa_map and similar nodes.
findings.route_or_state: gt_word -> c_gt_word_2 -> pp_shop -> c_pp_shop_0 -> pp_teach on an orchard or beacon start.

findings.problem: fn_ovens requires `biscuits_given`, a fact from the sheepfold thread, but is reached from the knock-doors payoff, which only gives `keepers_fetch_quad` and `ovens_said_yes_before`. That payoff itself requires `ovens_quad`, which is not part of its own thread and is established only at sf_ovens. fn_ovens describes Wren asking Mr Ovens herself, which contradicts the fact that Riley and Chen already fetched the quad.

oil_ration requires `four_litres_shop`, which gt_wind and oil_wick never establish. When it is reached after the sheepfold payoff, ration_fifty ('the paraffin to hand is four litres', flagged as contradicting barn_heater_can) asserts less fuel than Wren now holds.
findings.route_or_state: did_start_sheepfold_turn=true -> oil_can -> payoff site2 -> oil_ration; also gt_wind -> oil_wick -> oil_ration.

findings.problem: Many ending and decision nodes require facts that are unreachable on most or all routes into them. oil_bench needs `dot_mallow`. oil_fifty needs `tally_box`, `school_can` and `spare_fuel_found`. z_shoulder needs `shoulder_dark_twice`, which nothing establishes. z_tally needs `two_blown`. fn_hold needs `rota_chalked`.
findings.route_or_state: og start -> ... -> oil_bench; z_shoulder is unsatisfiable on every route.

findings.problem: Many gated choices can never be offered because the node holding them never establishes the required fact. Examples: the twins choices at the og_ nodes (`twins_kit_row` is only at og_twins), `two_blown` at pa_hang, pa_bag and pa_post, `shoulder` at pa_dim and oil_count, and `six_out` at fn_wait. Each fork silently collapses to fewer options, and the writer cannot tell which choices are live.
findings.route_or_state: og_hub -> og_hinge/og_low/og_fruit: the twins choice is never available.

findings.problem: A child walks alone up onto the bare dark shoulder, beyond the last lantern, on purpose (fn_up, pa_meet). This conflicts with the book's own 'NEVER ALONE' rule (pairs_rule) and is questionable for ages 8-11. The plan treats it as a neutral choice with no safeguard.
findings.route_or_state: Any route reaching fn_up or pa_meet.

findings.problem: Shared endings make claims that earlier route states contradict. fx_count_end says seventy-eight lanterns were counted and matched, but fn_count gives seventy-one lit, six out and three unhung. fx_hold_end claims an unbroken line of lights, but routes into it may have chosen thin filling or left spots unlit. fn_wait says the ridge is lit regardless of route.
findings.route_or_state: fn_count -> c_fn_count_1 -> fx_tally; oil_shades/oil_reserve (thirty dark) -> ... -> fx_hold_end.

findings.problem: Several sibling nodes reuse the same menu of three choices with identical intents and costs, regardless of the node's event. For example, bs_carry (hauling crates before the rain) offers the bracket-fixings choices. Many forks do not differ in a way the node motivates, and some have a single obvious best answer, such as 'give up on the turn' beside real options.
findings.route_or_state: bs_hub -> bs_carry -> c_bs_carry_0 ('find proper fixings', jar not there).
